suggestedPeers.name: kempo-smtp
suggestedPeers.reason: Email each submission to you, and a confirmation to the visitor, through your own SMTP server

suggestedPeers.name: kempo-resend
suggestedPeers.reason: Email each submission through Resend (use this or kempo-smtp)

widgets.title: Form submissions
widgets.description: New submissions today and this week, and the spam waiting for review.

page_widgets.title: Form
page_widgets.description: A form made under Forms in the admin, shown and sent from this page.

attributes.name: slug
attributes.label: Form
attributes.hint: The address of the form, such as contact.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.label: Heading
attributes.hint: Show the form's title above it as a heading of this level.

permissions.name: forms:forms:manage
permissions.description: Create, edit, duplicate, pause and archive forms, restore them from the Trash and empty it

permissions.name: forms:submissions:view
permissions.description: See submissions, their spam verdicts and history, and export them

permissions.name: forms:submissions:manage
permissions.description: Change a submission's status, add notes, resend notifications, move submissions to the Trash, restore them and empty the Trash

settings.name: site_url
settings.description: The address of this site, used for the links in emails, such as http://localhost:3000

settings.name: default_recipients
settings.description: Comma-separated addresses that get every new submission from forms that use the site-wide recipients

settings.name: email_notifications
settings.description: Email each new submission to its recipients. Needs an email extension such as kempo-resend or kempo-smtp, and can be turned on once one is installed

settings.name: require_account
settings.description: Only signed-in people can submit a form, unless the form says otherwise

settings.name: spam_action
settings.description: What happens to a submission a spam rule catches: spam keeps it for review without emailing it, reject refuses it without saving

settings.name: spam_rules
settings.description: Site-wide spam rules, each a regular expression tested against the submitted values

settings.name: rate_limit_per_hour
settings.description: Submission attempts one visitor can make in an hour, counted whether or not they were accepted. 0 turns the limit off

settings.name: max_field_length
settings.description: The most characters one field can hold, after trimming

settings.name: store_ip
settings.description: Keep the visitor's IP address with each submission. Off means it is never stored; the rate limit only keeps an unreadable hash

settings.name: trust_proxy
settings.description: Take the visitor's address from the X-Forwarded-For header. Turn this on only when the site is behind your own proxy; otherwise anyone can send that header and dodge the rate limit

settings.name: retention_days
settings.description: Delete submissions older than this many days. 0 keeps them forever

settings.name: spam_retention_days
settings.description: Delete spam older than this many days. 0 keeps it forever

settings.name: ip_salt
settings.description: Used to hash visitor addresses for the rate limit. Made automatically; changing it only resets the counts

settings.name: rich_text
settings.description: Rich text fields: off refuses both kinds, markdown accepts markdown fields, html also accepts rich text (HTML) fields. HTML is cleaned of scripts before it is stored

settings.name: upload_max_bytes
settings.description: The largest file a visitor can send in one upload, in bytes. Needs kempo-files

settings.name: upload_max_files
settings.description: The most files one submission can carry. Needs kempo-files

groups.name: kempo-forms:support
groups.description: Reads the submissions that come in and handles them, without being able to change forms

groups.name: kempo-forms:editor
groups.description: Builds forms and reads what comes in

groups.name: kempo-forms:administrator
groups.description: Everything: forms, submissions and the settings
